mapper.sql: a.article_id, a.title, a.content, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.user_id, a.category_id, a.status, a.view_count, a.create_time, a.update_time

a.article_id, a.title, SUBSTRING(a.content, 1, 200) AS content, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.user_id, a.category_id, a.status, a.view_count, a.create_time, a.update_time, u.nickname AS author_name, c.name AS category_name
mapper.select: SELECT a.article_id, a.title, a.content, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.user_id, a.category_id, a.status, a.view_count, a.create_time, a.update_time, u.nickname AS author_name, c.name AS category_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON a.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.category_id WHERE a.article_id = #{articleId}
SELECT FROM article a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON a.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.category_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
SELECT FROM article a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON a.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.category_id WHERE a.category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC

SELECT FROM article a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON a.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.category_id WHERE a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
SELECT FROM article a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON a.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.category_id WHERE a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article (title, content, summary, cover_image, user_id, category_id, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{summary}, #{coverImage}, #{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
